title: cacalia jugalis
intro: Cacalia jugalis, commonly known as Yellow Hairy Bells, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, wounds, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia jugalis include soothing and calming effects on the nervous system, making it a potential natural remedy for anxiety and stress relief. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
